content:
While some of the bigger fall Prime Day deals on Apple gear haven't kicked off yet, there are already plenty of notable discounts to grab right now, including $500 off the 2TB M5 Pro MacBook Pro, 80% off the new Beats 360 ear cushion set, and the Amazon low on AirTag 2.

We're also now tracking official fall Prime Day price drops across a range of favorite HomeKit smart home brands, including ecobee and a whole lineup of Eve smart plugs, outlets, switches, and more, plus new lows on the latest Belkin 25W MagSafe charging stands. Be sure to also check out the popular new Twelve South AirFly Drive wireless CarFly adapter while you're at it for $40.
